content:
Apple's new smart home hub, widely referred to as the "HomePad," is reportedly set to launch on October 13. The latest leaks have also revealed its color options at launch.

The HomePad is expected to come in Silver, Space Gray, Starlight, and Rose.

Last night, leaker pdfu shared some images that appear to show the HomePad's setup process. This isn't pdfu's first leak — they previously revealed new features for the iPhone Duo, many of which are likely to extend to the HomePad as well.

In a follow-up post, pdfu stated that the HomePad may come in four finishes:

  • Silver
  • Space Gray
  • Starlight
  • Rose

As shown in the images below, the HomePad's setup process appears to automatically display a preview graphic matching the finish of the model being configured.

According to previous reports, the HomePad will offer watchOS-like customizable watch faces for users to configure.

The images obtained by pdfy demonstrate how Apple's "Photo Face" will look on this new smart home hub, and also offer a glimpse of the upcoming square-shaped chassis design.

What do you think of the leaked HomePad color options? Let us know in the comments.
